name: dvd-harmonic-viewer
description: DVD 3D viewer for Gazebo Harmonic (gzweb SceneManager over the gz-launch websocket server). Replaces the Classic gzweb 1.4 page on port 8080.
//: @babel/runtime: imported by three-nebula (a gzweb dependency) but not declared by it.
protobufjs: same version gzweb resolves to; src/protoFixups.js patches that single instance.
call-import-namespace is silenced: gzweb's bundle does `new JSZip()` on a namespace import, which only breaks Scene.createThumbnails(); the viewer never calls it.
